description: Research index only. These records are not prediction rules and must not generate readings.

baseTextDecision.recommendedBaseline: 1952 edition, with earlier editions recorded as separate variants
baseTextDecision.reason: The five-volume corpus and later commentaries are not fully interchangeable; source and pinpoint references must be retained.

concepts.name: Teva / chart inventory
concepts.description: Define the chart structure and the exact mapping from calculated planetary positions to Lal Kitab house numbers.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Verify against the selected primary edition and record page/section.

concepts.name: Pakka Ghar
concepts.description: Research the traditional concept of a planet's fixed or permanent house and its precise rules.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Do not encode planet-to-house mappings until checked against the selected text.

concepts.name: Planet-in-house results
concepts.description: Conditional interpretations of planets in each of the twelve houses.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Each planet-house pair must cite a specific edition and page/section; preserve contradictions as edition-specific variants.

concepts.name: Occupied and empty houses
concepts.description: Rules that use the presence or absence of planets in houses.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Record all conditions and exceptions; do not infer a result from emptiness alone.

concepts.name: Planetary states
concepts.description: Research source-defined concepts sometimes rendered as sleeping, awake or blind planets.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Terminology and calculation method must be checked against the chosen edition.

concepts.name: Rin / debt concepts
concepts.description: Source-specific rules connecting planetary configurations to named forms of debt.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Avoid moral blame or claims of factual inherited causation; expose the reading as a traditional belief.

concepts.name: Totke / upay
concepts.description: Traditional remedy records linked to specific triggering rules.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Store exact procedure, source, timing if present, practical cautions and safety review. Never prescribe generically.

concepts.name: Annual chart / Varshaphal
concepts.description: Optional annual chart module if supported by the selected source corpus.
concepts.sourceRequirement: Research separately; do not assume it uses the same calculation or house rules as the birth Teva.
